lines.t: Wick's Wagon, wheels and wonders! One special today — just the one. Don't be greedy.
The special changes with the Keynotes on your belt. More chord, better stock. That's the Wick guarantee. Unwritten.
Wick's Wagon, wheels and wonders! One special today — just the one. Don't be greedy.
Stone Keynote AND a toxin one? Dorran must've liked you. He only smiles at granite, usually.
They've unchained the quarry lift for you. The Undertone's cold, so bring a jumper. And a troupe.
That was you on the ridge? Heard the whole thing from here. The Knell towers nearly rang along.
Knellstone's just through the arch. Cantor Dorran's back from his walk, so the Hall's open.
Knellstone's through the arch. Best bells in Cantarra — when they're in tune, anyway.
There's a kid in a red scarf pacing by the ridge cairn, telling their kin about 'the plan'. Loudly. For an hour.
Shifted it clean! I've been building walls round that boulder for a week. Now I've got a wall to nowhere.
Heave works on any stone glyph with that mark. Keep an eye out underground — miners love a good boulder.
Is that Wren's Keynote? Then you've got Heave! See the glyph on that boulder? It wants a stone voice.
Any stone kin in your troupe will do — fresh or fainted, the glyph doesn't mind. Stand close and resonate.
No stone kin yet? Rollith roll about the heather here. Weaken, don't wound, and ask nicely with a Chime.
Boulder's been sat on my shortcut since the stones went quiet. It's got a stone glyph on it, see?
Takes a stone voice and a Keynote that knows stone to shift it. Rootloft's Cantor hands those out.
{player}! You took your time. I've been rehearsing a speech. It's very good. Here it is.
Mum's got six Keynotes and a spire. I've got one Keynote and a *plan*. The plan is: beat you.
That was the whole speech. Ready?
Plan B is 'lose gracefully'. I'm workshopping it.
Saw some gale kin on the ridge. Mine loves updrafts. Just saying. For no reason.
Knellstone's over the arch. The Cantor's back from his walk — go on, I'll be… practising Plan B.
Mum's got six Keynotes and a spire. I've got one Keynote and a *plan*. The plan is: beat you.
Plan B is 'lose gracefully'. I'm workshopping it.
Ha! Plan A! It worked! Write that down somewhere official.
